seoTitle: Story Plot Generator: Hero, Setting, Conflict and Twist
metaDescription: Combine a random hero, setting, goal, opponent, twist and theme into a story premise. Free, runs in your browser.
intro: Combine a random hero, setting, goal, opponent and twist into a short story premise. Press run again for a new one.
why:
A premise needs a person who wants something, a place and something in the way. Starting from a random set can break a stale idea.

Each premise joins a hero with a trait, a setting, a goal, an opposing force, a twist and a theme from short lists. Make several, keep the ones that spark something and change the rest. Use a seed to repeat a list.
howTo: Set how many premises you want.
Keep one and rewrite it in your own words.

faq.q: Is the output a full plot?
faq.a: No. It is a premise. Structure and scenes are yours to write.
No. It picks items from fixed lists with a random number generator.
